title: Rows that ask for attention as callout cards: a severity label, a title, the rows it is about as chips, the explanation and a highlighted tip
about: Clashes, risks, warnings, findings, advice: each row a card that says how much it matters ('Act on this', 'Worth knowing', 'Helpful'), what it is, which things it is about (chips joined by a sign), why, and what to do. TONE and LABEL are SQL expressions over the row (a CASE on its severity column). Choose it over a table whenever the person is meant to act on each row.

head.about: the column with each card's title

chips.about: columns naming the things it is about, shown as chips (a list)

tip.about: the column with what to do

tone.about: an SQL expression giving bad, warn, ok or info for the row

label.about: an SQL expression giving the severity words (default by tone: Act on this, Worth knowing, Helpful, Note)

where.about: an SQL condition on the rows

order.about: SQL ORDER BY: most pressing first

example.title: Risks
example.head: title
example.tone: CASE severity WHEN 'high' THEN 'bad' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'warn' ELSE 'info' END

data.{{key}}: SELECT *, {{tone}} AS sa_tone{{label|wrap:, ~ AS sa_label}} FROM {{table}}{{where|pre: WHERE }} ORDER BY {{order}} LIMIT 100

let.{{key}}_items: ={{key}}.map(r => ({tone: r.sa_tone, label: r.sa_label || null, title: r.{{head}}, chips: ({{chips|json}} || []).map(c => r[c]).filter(x => x != null && x !== ''), join: {{join|json}}, text: {{text|json}} ? r[{{text|json}}] : null, tip: {{tip|json}} ? r[{{tip|json}}] : null}))
